status_definitions.VERIFIED: The exact artifact and field, table, equation, page, or function were inspected and a small repository fixture records the reviewed contract.
status_definitions.LIMITED: The exact artifact was inspected, but its scope does not cover every category input, scenario, or role.
status_definitions.UNVERIFIED: The source is relevant, but the exact adapter field or calculation contract has not been proved with a reviewed fixture.
status_definitions.UNSUPPORTED: The inspected source does not support the claimed role or use.

standards.manual_review_verdict: The release can support an archetype simulation delta after a reviewed crosswalk and aggregate fixture exist. It cannot establish a project-specific exact existing or proposed product.
Scout is a segment-level ECM method. The category crosswalk and exact performance fields still need reviewed source fixtures.
Current certification records can support an exact current product after a product-specific export is reviewed. They do not supply a representative installed existing-equipment population.

The commercial dishwasher schema and separate AC-output and DC-output EVSE exports prove their named proposed-product fields. Other product families and all existing-equipment or usage claims remain unverified or unsupported.

The umbrella MEASUR claim is insufficient for implementation proof. Every category must identify its exact module, inputs, units, outputs, code function, and golden example while unresolved inputs continue through the single-value fallback policy.
SAM can calculate performance after design, weather, load, and backup inputs are supplied. It is not a source for those missing project inputs.

The API field contract is verified, but required system design inputs are project facts and the simulator does not supply a missing design. Any unresolved design input must be selected before simulation through the separate single-value fallback policy.
The simulator requires an explicit turbine, power curve, hub height, losses, and resource selection. Those values cannot be supplied by the simulator itself.
The official database and matching contract are verified. Exact execution remains limited until a published utility tariff, normalized adapter, and monthly bill-reconciliation fixture are retained.
REopt can calculate dispatch only after a complete chronological load, tariff, technology, and operating constraint set is provided.
EPA technology and capacity rows can support proposed screening classes and a transparent energy balance. They do not identify exact equipment or supply site design and coincidence inputs.
Exact vehicle records and units are verified. Class distributions are disabled until compatibility filters and sample-size fixtures are reviewed.
WaterSense criteria support proposed performance. Existing installed ratings and commercial usage frequency remain separate unresolved inputs.
Version 2.0 compares designed landscape water use with typical standard new construction. It does not measure actual consumption or determine irrigation scheduling.
The relevant leak and cooling-tower equations still require exact page, equation, and worked-example fixtures before they can resolve a default path.
Table 1 provides proposed efficacy requirements. Table 2 is one narrow wall-mounted example. Neither supplies a general existing legacy-wattage distribution.
Explicit calendar arithmetic and daylight calculations are defensible after all inputs are supplied. A business label alone does not prove annual operating hours.

Reviewed fixtures prove DOE outdoor lighting, EPA commercial flush activity, the narrow Argonne forklift pair, the ENERGY STAR electric-cooktop duty, DOE walk-in component rows, and the ENERGY STAR dishwasher rack-machine activity method. EVI-Pro Lite documentation supports only a normalized charging time-of-day shape, not site daily energy or utilization. Other category adapters remain implementation-pending and must disclose source and population limitations.

The retained March 2024 ENERGY STAR calculator fixture proves the building and booster water-heating equations and numeric inputs. The category adapter and end-to-end golden fixture remain implementation-pending.
